title: Raw DXF translated references to reminted table records
scope: Preserve raw DXF object references when referenced table records receive newly emitted handles
Use an existing generated MLEADERSTYLE round trip as the smallest production-path reproducer
Keep the change local to raw handle replay and avoid promoting support claims

finding.failure: Translated handle-reference codes consulted structural, block-record, and minted-object mappings, but did not consult sourceHandleToWrittenTableMap populated by table-record emission.
finding.observedControl: The generated MLEADERSTYLE code-342 reference named source STYLE handle 0x31 while table output reminted the STYLE record. Readback then could not resolve the reference to the emitted STYLE target.
finding.correction: When raw source-handle remapping is enabled, consult the emitted-table map after structural/block mappings and before generic minted-object mappings. Structural mappings retain precedence.

controls: Corrected generated MLEADERSTYLE code 341 to target a BLOCK_RECORD and code 342 to target STYLE.
Marked the synthetic typed-only serializer receipt as test plumbing, not a real DWG read or external evidence.
Existing ASCII and Binary readback assertions verify a unique target for all four rooted MLEADERSTYLE property references.
